assumptions.Name: moe_routing
assumptions.Scope: fused: the TRT-LLM monolithic experts are first in the oracle's order and take router logits; the model's routing method is taken to be one they support (DeepSeekV3, Renormalize, Sigmoid or MiniMax2), as every catalog MoE family's is

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: an fp32 router gate above 32 tokens runs bf16x3 on a Blackwell part (gate_linear.py:116-136): three BF16 GEMMs, a third of the BF16 peak, on the BF16 ramp

assumptions.Name: gemm_eps_max_nvfp4_grouped
assumptions.Scope: nvfp4: no efficiency ramp for the nvfp4_grouped kernel on b300, so it is priced on the nvfp4 ramp at the peak it computes at

assumptions.Name: all_reduce_message_limit
assumptions.Scope: the custom lane for every message size: the engine runs a message above the custom kernel's size limit on NCCL; the pool's tensor-parallel all-reduce is priced from the custom lane at every size (inference-sim/inference-sim#2478)

assumptions.Name: trtllm_gen_prefill_lane
assumptions.Scope: pooled: the trtllm-gen prefill pair cannot be shown valid for the prefill implementation reported (no implementation reported for attention.prefill): attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_bf16 is valid for flashinfer/trtllm_batch_context_with_kv_cache/9be0f76701ed318b1e2d52a5662f7df33e9597a80445452d57a78c99bc29fbca, and the engine reports no implementation of attention.prefill; attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_bf16 is valid for flashinfer/trtllm_batch_context_with_kv_cache/21456cf0dbe7b20b1f233422c3d97802aef4bb236f4cc308b5f2852db18a59b8, and the engine reports no implementation of attention.prefill; attention_prefill_work_scale_trtllm_gen_kv_bf16 is valid for flashinfer/trtllm_batch_context_with_kv_cache/9be0f76701ed318b1e2d52a5662f7df33e9597a80445452d57a78c99bc29fbca, and the engine reports no implementation of attention.prefill; attention_prefill_work_scale_trtllm_gen_kv_bf16 is valid for flashinfer/trtllm_batch_context_with_kv_cache/21456cf0dbe7b20b1f233422c3d97802aef4bb236f4cc308b5f2852db18a59b8, and the engine reports no implementation of attention.prefill; a different build or kernel, or a prefill that also runs another, is not priced from it; attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_fp8 is valid for flashinfer/trtllm_batch_context_with_kv_cache/9be0f76701ed318b1e2d52a5662f7df33e9597a80445452d57a78c99bc29fbca, and the engine reports no implementation of attention.prefill; attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_fp8 is valid for flashinfer/trtllm_batch_context_with_kv_cache/21456cf0dbe7b20b1f233422c3d97802aef4bb236f4cc308b5f2852db18a59b8, and the engine reports no implementation of attention.prefill; attention_prefill_work_scale_trtllm_gen_kv_fp8 is valid for flashinfer/trtllm_batch_context_with_kv_cache/9be0f76701ed318b1e2d52a5662f7df33e9597a80445452d57a78c99bc29fbca, and the engine reports no implementation of attention.prefill; attention_prefill_work_scale_trtllm_gen_kv_fp8 is valid for flashinfer/trtllm_batch_context_with_kv_cache/21456cf0dbe7b20b1f233422c3d97802aef4bb236f4cc308b5f2852db18a59b8, and the engine reports no implementation of attention.prefill; a different build or kernel, or a prefill that also runs another, is not priced from it. Needed: the code hash of the trtllm-gen prefill kernel of the engine's FlashInfer pin, which an engine release's kernel_impls.json would publish (inference-sim/inference-sim#2466), stated on the entries and reported by the engine as the implementation of attention.prefill. The part's pooled pair prices the prefill.

assumptions.Name: nontorch_in_budget_bytes_2rank
assumptions.Scope: 0: no fit-unit group measures the non-torch memory vLLM grows inside the KV budget for this model and part (non_kv_cache_memory, gpu_worker.py:720-756@v0.33.0), so none is charged and the KV budget is overstated by it

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.34.0+0fda86a35419 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

assumptions.Name: modality
assumptions.Scope: multimodal: the graph prices a vision tower, but the engine states none resident, so the tower's weights and any encode step are not priced

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: an fp32 router gate above 32 tokens runs bf16x3 on a Blackwell part (gate_linear.py:116-136): three BF16 GEMMs, a third of the BF16 peak, on the BF16 ramp

assumptions.Name: all_reduce_message_limit
assumptions.Scope: the custom lane for every message size: the engine runs a message above the custom kernel's size limit on NCCL; the pool's tensor-parallel all-reduce is priced from the custom lane at every size (inference-sim/inference-sim#2478)

assumptions.Name: trtllm_gen_prefill_lane
assumptions.Scope: pooled: the trtllm-gen prefill pair cannot be shown valid for the prefill implementation reported (no implementation reported for attention.prefill): attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_bf16 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs; attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_fp8 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs. Needed: the code hash of the trtllm-gen prefill kernel of the engine's FlashInfer pin, which an engine release's kernel_impls.json would publish (inference-sim/inference-sim#2466), stated on the entries and reported by the engine as the implementation of attention.prefill. The part's pooled pair prices the prefill.

assumptions.Name: num_spec_tokens
assumptions.Scope: 3: the deployment drafts 3 tokens a step and the graph's speculator states 1; the passes are priced at the deployment's count, and what the graph sizes at its own count is taken as stated

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: nontorch_in_budget_bytes_4rank
assumptions.Scope: 0: no fit-unit group measures the non-torch memory vLLM grows inside the KV budget for this model and part (non_kv_cache_memory, gpu_worker.py:720-756@v0.33.0), so none is charged and the KV budget is overstated by it

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.34.0+0fda86a35419 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

assumptions.Name: moe_routing
assumptions.Scope: fused: the TRT-LLM monolithic experts are first in the oracle's order and take router logits; the model's routing method is taken to be one they support (DeepSeekV3, Renormalize, Sigmoid or MiniMax2), as every catalog MoE family's is

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: an fp32 router gate above 32 tokens runs bf16x3 on a Blackwell part (gate_linear.py:116-136): three BF16 GEMMs, a third of the BF16 peak, on the BF16 ramp

assumptions.Name: all_reduce_message_limit
assumptions.Scope: the custom lane for every message size: the engine runs a message above the custom kernel's size limit on NCCL; the pool's tensor-parallel all-reduce is priced from the custom lane at every size (inference-sim/inference-sim#2478)

assumptions.Name: trtllm_gen_prefill_lane
assumptions.Scope: pooled: the trtllm-gen prefill pair cannot be shown valid for the prefill implementation reported (no implementation reported for attention.prefill): attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_bf16 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs; attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_fp8 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs. Needed: the code hash of the trtllm-gen prefill kernel of the engine's FlashInfer pin, which an engine release's kernel_impls.json would publish (inference-sim/inference-sim#2466), stated on the entries and reported by the engine as the implementation of attention.prefill. The part's pooled pair prices the prefill.

assumptions.Name: nontorch_in_budget_bytes_4rank
assumptions.Scope: 0: no fit-unit group measures the non-torch memory vLLM grows inside the KV budget for this model and part (non_kv_cache_memory, gpu_worker.py:720-756@v0.33.0), so none is charged and the KV budget is overstated by it

assumptions.Name: routing_imbalance
assumptions.Scope: 1 (evenly loaded): no default-role routing profile for minimax-m2.5//decode/linear/ep4: every expert-parallel rank is priced at the mean rank's routed tokens and experts

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.34.0+0fda86a35419 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

assumptions.Name: moe_routing
assumptions.Scope: : the experts class vLLM resolves for mxfp4 routed experts (moe_backend "") is not resolved here, so no selection launch is counted

assumptions.Name: all_reduce_message_limit
assumptions.Scope: the custom lane for every message size: the engine runs a message above the custom kernel's size limit on NCCL; the pool's tensor-parallel all-reduce is priced from the custom lane at every size (inference-sim/inference-sim#2478)

assumptions.Name: trtllm_gen_prefill_lane
assumptions.Scope: pooled: the trtllm-gen prefill pair cannot be shown valid for the prefill implementation reported (no implementation reported for attention.prefill): attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_bf16 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs; attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_fp8 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs. Needed: the code hash of the trtllm-gen prefill kernel of the engine's FlashInfer pin, which an engine release's kernel_impls.json would publish (inference-sim/inference-sim#2466), stated on the entries and reported by the engine as the implementation of attention.prefill. The part's pooled pair prices the prefill.

assumptions.Name: nontorch_in_budget_bytes_2rank
assumptions.Scope: 0: no fit-unit group measures the non-torch memory vLLM grows inside the KV budget for this model and part (non_kv_cache_memory, gpu_worker.py:720-756@v0.33.0), so none is charged and the KV budget is overstated by it

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.34.0+0fda86a35419 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

assumptions.Name: moe_routing
assumptions.Scope: : the experts class vLLM resolves for mxfp4 routed experts (moe_backend "") is not resolved here, so no selection launch is counted

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: FP32 weights run at the TF32 tensor-core rate, taken as half the dense BF16 peak as NVIDIA's datasheets state it for every catalog part; the catalog states no TF32 peak, and the ramp is BF16's

assumptions.Name: all_reduce_message_limit
assumptions.Scope: the custom lane for every message size: the engine runs a message above the custom kernel's size limit on NCCL; the pool's tensor-parallel all-reduce is priced from the custom lane at every size (inference-sim/inference-sim#2478)

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_sparse_mla
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no per-kind decode rate for sparse_mla attention, so it is priced with the part-wide attention pair and any per-kind floor is not used

assumptions.Name: sparse_read_per_query
assumptions.Scope: 1 + num_spec_tokens: a verify step's sparse attention is charged one window-and-top-k read per query token, as vLLM gathers them (vllm/models/deepseek_v41/nvidia/flashmla.py:200-203); the registry's sparse rate was fitted on single-token decode, and how much of that read a request's tokens share in cache was never measured

assumptions.Name: num_spec_tokens
assumptions.Scope: 2: the deployment drafts 2 tokens a step and the graph's speculator states 1; the passes are priced at the deployment's count, and what the graph sizes at its own count is taken as stated

assumptions.Name: cache_record
assumptions.Scope: fp8: the graph lists no record under this cache dtype for some cache it states, so that cache is sized at its bytes_per_entry, the record under the cache dtype the graph's base description assumes

assumptions.Name: kv_cache_grouping
assumptions.Scope: per cache: the stated caches are sized at their own pages rather than in the engine's shared block pool, because the rules pack cannot group them: an unbalanced bucket of 91 layers would be split 3 ways, which leaves layers in no group

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_sparse_mla
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for sparse_mla attention, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on the attention FLOPs

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: mhc_rate_pre
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured mHC pre form, so the hyper-connection nodes are charged their stated bytes at HBM bandwidth and the hc_*fn GEMMs on the dense ramp

assumptions.Name: mhc_rate_post
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured mHC post form, so the hyper-connection nodes are charged their stated bytes at HBM bandwidth and the hc_*fn GEMMs on the dense ramp

assumptions.Name: nontorch_in_budget_bytes_4rank
assumptions.Scope: 0: no fit-unit group measures the non-torch memory vLLM grows inside the KV budget for this model and part (non_kv_cache_memory, gpu_worker.py:720-756@v0.33.0), so none is charged and the KV budget is overstated by it

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.34.0+0fda86a35419 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

assumptions.Name: moe_routing
assumptions.Scope: : the experts class vLLM resolves for mxfp4 routed experts (moe_backend "") is not resolved here, so no selection launch is counted

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: FP32 weights run at the TF32 tensor-core rate, taken as half the dense BF16 peak as NVIDIA's datasheets state it for every catalog part; the catalog states no TF32 peak, and the ramp is BF16's

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_sparse_mla
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no per-kind decode rate for sparse_mla attention, so it is priced with the part-wide attention pair and any per-kind floor is not used

assumptions.Name: cache_record
assumptions.Scope: fp8: the graph lists no record under this cache dtype for some cache it states, so that cache is sized at its bytes_per_entry, the record under the cache dtype the graph's base description assumes

assumptions.Name: kv_cache_grouping
assumptions.Scope: per cache: the stated caches are sized at their own pages rather than in the engine's shared block pool, because the rules pack cannot group them: an unbalanced bucket of 91 layers would be split 3 ways, which leaves layers in no group

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_sparse_mla
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for sparse_mla attention, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on the attention FLOPs

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: mhc_rate_pre
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured mHC pre form, so the hyper-connection nodes are charged their stated bytes at HBM bandwidth and the hc_*fn GEMMs on the dense ramp

assumptions.Name: mhc_rate_post
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured mHC post form, so the hyper-connection nodes are charged their stated bytes at HBM bandwidth and the hc_*fn GEMMs on the dense ramp

assumptions.Name: nontorch_in_budget_bytes_1rank
assumptions.Scope: 0: no fit-unit group measures the non-torch memory vLLM grows inside the KV budget for this model and part (non_kv_cache_memory, gpu_worker.py:720-756@v0.33.0), so none is charged and the KV budget is overstated by it

assumptions.Name: routing_imbalance
assumptions.Scope: 1 (evenly loaded): no default-role routing profile for deepseek-v4-pro//decode/linear/ep8: every expert-parallel rank is priced at the mean rank's routed tokens and experts

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.34.0+0fda86a35419 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

settings.note: priced as {"moe_backend": null}: a stated backend (FlashInfer TRT-LLM, CUTLASS or CuteDSL, DeepGEMM mega-MoE, Marlin, or Triton) runs its own kernel with its own ramp; the experts are priced as the engine resolves the field when it is unset, so the step carries that backend's difference. On an SM90 part with block-FP8 experts the engine prices a stated Triton or FlashInfer CUTLASS backend from its own lane (the plan states the kernel, lowering expertsKernel); the point is still carried as this substitution because the unset field resolves Triton at expert-parallel width 1 and FlashInfer CUTLASS above it, so a stated backend that is not that one is priced from the other's lane. A stated marlin on an SM90 part with MXFP4 experts is the kernel the engine already prices: a part with no four-bit peak prices MXFP4 grouped routed experts as vLLM's Marlin W4A16 grouped GEMM on the registry's w4a16_mxfp4_grouped ramp (blis-substrate kernel formatFit; registry fit_marlin_grouped_ramp.py), while the unset field resolves Triton for gpt-oss on SM90 (oracle/mxfp4.py _get_priority_backends_for_gpt_oss, TRITON before MARLIN, vllm@4ba787ec). The SM90 clause is valid for block-FP8 experts (Triton, FlashInfer CUTLASS) and for MXFP4 experts (Marlin) only; the clause grammar cannot test the weight scheme (inference-sim/inference-sim#2525)), and the corpus has no other SM90 recipe that states any of these backends (the registry prices a routed expert group by weight format on the ramp fitted for it (inference-sim/inference-sim#2394, inference-sim/blis-substrate#285), and records that the stated backend is not the one it measured)

assumptions.Name: moe_routing
assumptions.Scope: : the experts class vLLM resolves for mxfp4 routed experts (moe_backend "") is not resolved here, so no selection launch is counted

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: FP32 weights run at the TF32 tensor-core rate, taken as half the dense BF16 peak as NVIDIA's datasheets state it for every catalog part; the catalog states no TF32 peak, and the ramp is BF16's

assumptions.Name: all_reduce_message_limit
assumptions.Scope: the custom lane for every message size: the engine runs a message above the custom kernel's size limit on NCCL; the pool's tensor-parallel all-reduce is priced from the custom lane at every size (inference-sim/inference-sim#2478)

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_sparse_mla
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no per-kind decode rate for sparse_mla attention, so it is priced with the part-wide attention pair and any per-kind floor is not used

assumptions.Name: cache_record
assumptions.Scope: fp8: the graph lists no record under this cache dtype for some cache it states, so that cache is sized at its bytes_per_entry, the record under the cache dtype the graph's base description assumes

assumptions.Name: kv_cache_grouping
assumptions.Scope: per cache: the stated caches are sized at their own pages rather than in the engine's shared block pool, because the rules pack cannot group them: an unbalanced bucket of 91 layers would be split 3 ways, which leaves layers in no group

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_sparse_mla
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for sparse_mla attention, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on the attention FLOPs

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: mhc_rate_pre
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured mHC pre form, so the hyper-connection nodes are charged their stated bytes at HBM bandwidth and the hc_*fn GEMMs on the dense ramp

assumptions.Name: mhc_rate_post
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured mHC post form, so the hyper-connection nodes are charged their stated bytes at HBM bandwidth and the hc_*fn GEMMs on the dense ramp

assumptions.Name: nontorch_in_budget_bytes_8rank
assumptions.Scope: 0: no fit-unit group measures the non-torch memory vLLM grows inside the KV budget for this model and part (non_kv_cache_memory, gpu_worker.py:720-756@v0.33.0), so none is charged and the KV budget is overstated by it

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.34.0+0fda86a35419 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

settings.note: priced as {"moe_backend": null}: a stated backend (FlashInfer TRT-LLM, CUTLASS or CuteDSL, DeepGEMM mega-MoE, Marlin, or Triton) runs its own kernel with its own ramp; the experts are priced as the engine resolves the field when it is unset, so the step carries that backend's difference. On an SM90 part with block-FP8 experts the engine prices a stated Triton or FlashInfer CUTLASS backend from its own lane (the plan states the kernel, lowering expertsKernel); the point is still carried as this substitution because the unset field resolves Triton at expert-parallel width 1 and FlashInfer CUTLASS above it, so a stated backend that is not that one is priced from the other's lane. A stated marlin on an SM90 part with MXFP4 experts is the kernel the engine already prices: a part with no four-bit peak prices MXFP4 grouped routed experts as vLLM's Marlin W4A16 grouped GEMM on the registry's w4a16_mxfp4_grouped ramp (blis-substrate kernel formatFit; registry fit_marlin_grouped_ramp.py), while the unset field resolves Triton for gpt-oss on SM90 (oracle/mxfp4.py _get_priority_backends_for_gpt_oss, TRITON before MARLIN, vllm@4ba787ec). The SM90 clause is valid for block-FP8 experts (Triton, FlashInfer CUTLASS) and for MXFP4 experts (Marlin) only; the clause grammar cannot test the weight scheme (inference-sim/inference-sim#2525)), and the corpus has no other SM90 recipe that states any of these backends (the registry prices a routed expert group by weight format on the ramp fitted for it (inference-sim/inference-sim#2394, inference-sim/blis-substrate#285), and records that the stated backend is not the one it measured)

assumptions.Name: all_reduce_message_limit
assumptions.Scope: the custom lane for every message size: the engine runs a message above the custom kernel's size limit on NCCL; the pool's tensor-parallel all-reduce is priced from the custom lane at every size (inference-sim/inference-sim#2478)

assumptions.Name: nontorch_in_budget_bytes_4rank
assumptions.Scope: 0: no fit-unit group measures the non-torch memory vLLM grows inside the KV budget for this model and part (non_kv_cache_memory, gpu_worker.py:720-756@v0.33.0), so none is charged and the KV budget is overstated by it

assumptions.Name: engine_version

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: an fp32 router gate above 32 tokens runs bf16x3 on a Blackwell part (gate_linear.py:116-136): three BF16 GEMMs, a third of the BF16 peak, on the BF16 ramp

assumptions.Name: all_reduce_message_limit
assumptions.Scope: the custom lane for every message size: the engine runs a message above the custom kernel's size limit on NCCL; the pool's tensor-parallel all-reduce is priced from the custom lane at every size (inference-sim/inference-sim#2478)

assumptions.Name: trtllm_gen_prefill_lane
assumptions.Scope: pooled: the trtllm-gen prefill pair cannot be shown valid for the prefill implementation reported (no implementation reported for attention.prefill): attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_bf16 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs; attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_fp8 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs. Needed: the code hash of the trtllm-gen prefill kernel of the engine's FlashInfer pin, which an engine release's kernel_impls.json would publish (inference-sim/inference-sim#2466), stated on the entries and reported by the engine as the implementation of attention.prefill. The part's pooled pair prices the prefill.

assumptions.Name: num_spec_tokens
assumptions.Scope: 3: the deployment drafts 3 tokens a step and the graph's speculator states 1; the passes are priced at the deployment's count, and what the graph sizes at its own count is taken as stated

assumptions.Name: cache_record
assumptions.Scope: fp8: the graph lists no record under this cache dtype for some cache it states, so that cache is sized at its bytes_per_entry, the record under the cache dtype the graph's base description assumes

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: nontorch_in_budget_bytes_4rank

assumptions.Name: moe_routing
assumptions.Scope: fused: the TRT-LLM monolithic experts are first in the oracle's order and take router logits; the model's routing method is taken to be one they support (DeepSeekV3, Renormalize, Sigmoid or MiniMax2), as every catalog MoE family's is

assumptions.Name: modality
assumptions.Scope: multimodal: the graph prices a vision tower, but the engine states none resident, so the tower's weights and any encode step are not priced

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: an fp32 router gate above 32 tokens runs bf16x3 on a Blackwell part (gate_linear.py:116-136): three BF16 GEMMs, a third of the BF16 peak, on the BF16 ramp

assumptions.Name: gemm_eps_max_nvfp4_grouped
assumptions.Scope: nvfp4: no efficiency ramp for the nvfp4_grouped kernel on b300, so it is priced on the nvfp4 ramp at the peak it computes at

assumptions.Name: all_reduce_message_limit
assumptions.Scope: the custom lane for every message size: the engine runs a message above the custom kernel's size limit on NCCL; the pool's tensor-parallel all-reduce is priced from the custom lane at every size (inference-sim/inference-sim#2478)

assumptions.Name: trtllm_gen_prefill_lane
assumptions.Scope: pooled: the trtllm-gen prefill pair cannot be shown valid for the prefill implementation reported (no implementation reported for attention.prefill): attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_bf16 is valid for flashinfer/trtllm_batch_context_with_kv_cache/9be0f76701ed318b1e2d52a5662f7df33e9597a80445452d57a78c99bc29fbca, and the engine reports no implementation of attention.prefill; attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_bf16 is valid for flashinfer/trtllm_batch_context_with_kv_cache/21456cf0dbe7b20b1f233422c3d97802aef4bb236f4cc308b5f2852db18a59b8, and the engine reports no implementation of attention.prefill; attention_prefill_work_scale_trtllm_gen_kv_bf16 is valid for flashinfer/trtllm_batch_context_with_kv_cache/9be0f76701ed318b1e2d52a5662f7df33e9597a80445452d57a78c99bc29fbca, and the engine reports no implementation of attention.prefill; attention_prefill_work_scale_trtllm_gen_kv_bf16 is valid for flashinfer/trtllm_batch_context_with_kv_cache/21456cf0dbe7b20b1f233422c3d97802aef4bb236f4cc308b5f2852db18a59b8, and the engine reports no implementation of attention.prefill; a different build or kernel, or a prefill that also runs another, is not priced from it; attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_fp8 is valid for flashinfer/trtllm_batch_context_with_kv_cache/9be0f76701ed318b1e2d52a5662f7df33e9597a80445452d57a78c99bc29fbca, and the engine reports no implementation of attention.prefill; attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_fp8 is valid for flashinfer/trtllm_batch_context_with_kv_cache/21456cf0dbe7b20b1f233422c3d97802aef4bb236f4cc308b5f2852db18a59b8, and the engine reports no implementation of attention.prefill; attention_prefill_work_scale_trtllm_gen_kv_fp8 is valid for flashinfer/trtllm_batch_context_with_kv_cache/9be0f76701ed318b1e2d52a5662f7df33e9597a80445452d57a78c99bc29fbca, and the engine reports no implementation of attention.prefill; attention_prefill_work_scale_trtllm_gen_kv_fp8 is valid for flashinfer/trtllm_batch_context_with_kv_cache/21456cf0dbe7b20b1f233422c3d97802aef4bb236f4cc308b5f2852db18a59b8, and the engine reports no implementation of attention.prefill; a different build or kernel, or a prefill that also runs another, is not priced from it. Needed: the code hash of the trtllm-gen prefill kernel of the engine's FlashInfer pin, which an engine release's kernel_impls.json would publish (inference-sim/inference-sim#2466), stated on the entries and reported by the engine as the implementation of attention.prefill. The part's pooled pair prices the prefill.

assumptions.Name: num_spec_tokens
assumptions.Scope: 3: the deployment drafts 3 tokens a step and the graph's speculator states 1; the passes are priced at the deployment's count, and what the graph sizes at its own count is taken as stated

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: nontorch_in_budget_bytes_4rank
assumptions.Scope: 0: no fit-unit group measures the non-torch memory vLLM grows inside the KV budget for this model and part (non_kv_cache_memory, gpu_worker.py:720-756@v0.33.0), so none is charged and the KV budget is overstated by it

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.34.0+0fda86a35419 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

assumptions.Name: moe_routing
assumptions.Scope: fused: the TRT-LLM monolithic experts are first in the oracle's order and take router logits; the model's routing method is taken to be one they support (DeepSeekV3, Renormalize, Sigmoid or MiniMax2), as every catalog MoE family's is

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: an fp32 router gate above 32 tokens runs bf16x3 on a Blackwell part (gate_linear.py:116-136): three BF16 GEMMs, a third of the BF16 peak, on the BF16 ramp

assumptions.Name: all_reduce_message_limit
assumptions.Scope: the custom lane for every message size: the engine runs a message above the custom kernel's size limit on NCCL; the pool's tensor-parallel all-reduce is priced from the custom lane at every size (inference-sim/inference-sim#2478)

assumptions.Name: trtllm_gen_prefill_lane
assumptions.Scope: pooled: the trtllm-gen prefill pair cannot be shown valid for the prefill implementation reported (no implementation reported for attention.prefill): attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_bf16 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs; attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_fp8 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs. Needed: the code hash of the trtllm-gen prefill kernel of the engine's FlashInfer pin, which an engine release's kernel_impls.json would publish (inference-sim/inference-sim#2466), stated on the entries and reported by the engine as the implementation of attention.prefill. The part's pooled pair prices the prefill.

assumptions.Name: nontorch_in_budget_bytes_2rank
assumptions.Scope: 0: no fit-unit group measures the non-torch memory vLLM grows inside the KV budget for this model and part (non_kv_cache_memory, gpu_worker.py:720-756@v0.33.0), so none is charged and the KV budget is overstated by it

assumptions.Name: routing_imbalance

assumptions.Name: engine_version

assumptions.Name: moe_routing
assumptions.Scope: fused: the TRT-LLM monolithic experts are first in the oracle's order and take router logits; the model's routing method is taken to be one they support (DeepSeekV3, Renormalize, Sigmoid or MiniMax2), as every catalog MoE family's is

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: an fp32 router gate above 32 tokens runs bf16x3 on a Blackwell part (gate_linear.py:116-136): three BF16 GEMMs, a third of the BF16 peak, on the BF16 ramp

assumptions.Name: all_reduce_message_limit
assumptions.Scope: the custom lane for every message size: the engine runs a message above the custom kernel's size limit on NCCL; the pool's tensor-parallel all-reduce is priced from the custom lane at every size (inference-sim/inference-sim#2478)

assumptions.Name: trtllm_gen_prefill_lane
assumptions.Scope: pooled: the trtllm-gen prefill pair cannot be shown valid for the prefill implementation reported (no implementation reported for attention.prefill): attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_bf16 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs; attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_fp8 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs. Needed: the code hash of the trtllm-gen prefill kernel of the engine's FlashInfer pin, which an engine release's kernel_impls.json would publish (inference-sim/inference-sim#2466), stated on the entries and reported by the engine as the implementation of attention.prefill. The part's pooled pair prices the prefill.

assumptions.Name: nontorch_in_budget_bytes_4rank
assumptions.Scope: 0: no fit-unit group measures the non-torch memory vLLM grows inside the KV budget for this model and part (non_kv_cache_memory, gpu_worker.py:720-756@v0.33.0), so none is charged and the KV budget is overstated by it

assumptions.Name: routing_imbalance
assumptions.Scope: 1 (evenly loaded): no default-role routing profile for minimax-m2.5//decode/linear/ep4: every expert-parallel rank is priced at the mean rank's routed tokens and experts

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.34.0+0fda86a35419 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

assumptions.Name: moe_routing
assumptions.Scope: fused: the TRT-LLM monolithic experts are first in the oracle's order and take router logits; the model's routing method is taken to be one they support (DeepSeekV3, Renormalize, Sigmoid or MiniMax2), as every catalog MoE family's is

assumptions.Name: modality
assumptions.Scope: multimodal: the graph prices a vision tower, but the engine states none resident, so the tower's weights and any encode step are not priced

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: an fp32 router gate above 32 tokens runs bf16x3 on a Blackwell part (gate_linear.py:116-136): three BF16 GEMMs, a third of the BF16 peak, on the BF16 ramp

assumptions.Name: gemm_eps_max_nvfp4_grouped
assumptions.Scope: nvfp4: no efficiency ramp for the nvfp4_grouped kernel on b200, so it is priced on the nvfp4 ramp at the peak it computes at

assumptions.Name: all_reduce_message_limit
assumptions.Scope: the custom lane for every message size: the engine runs a message above the custom kernel's size limit on NCCL; the pool's tensor-parallel all-reduce is priced from the custom lane at every size (inference-sim/inference-sim#2478)

assumptions.Name: trtllm_gen_prefill_lane
assumptions.Scope: pooled: the trtllm-gen prefill pair cannot be shown valid for the prefill implementation reported (no implementation reported for attention.prefill): attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_bf16 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs; attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_fp8 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs. Needed: the code hash of the trtllm-gen prefill kernel of the engine's FlashInfer pin, which an engine release's kernel_impls.json would publish (inference-sim/inference-sim#2466), stated on the entries and reported by the engine as the implementation of attention.prefill. The part's pooled pair prices the prefill.

assumptions.Name: num_spec_tokens
assumptions.Scope: 3: the deployment drafts 3 tokens a step and the graph's speculator states 1; the passes are priced at the deployment's count, and what the graph sizes at its own count is taken as stated

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: nontorch_in_budget_bytes_4rank
assumptions.Scope: 0: no fit-unit group measures the non-torch memory vLLM grows inside the KV budget for this model and part (non_kv_cache_memory, gpu_worker.py:720-756@v0.33.0), so none is charged and the KV budget is overstated by it

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.34.0+0fda86a35419 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

assumptions.Name: moe_routing
assumptions.Scope: fused: the TRT-LLM monolithic experts are first in the oracle's order and take router logits; the model's routing method is taken to be one they support (DeepSeekV3, Renormalize, Sigmoid or MiniMax2), as every catalog MoE family's is

assumptions.Name: modality
assumptions.Scope: multimodal: the graph prices a vision tower, but the engine states none resident, so the tower's weights and any encode step are not priced

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: an fp32 router gate above 32 tokens runs bf16x3 on a Blackwell part (gate_linear.py:116-136): three BF16 GEMMs, a third of the BF16 peak, on the BF16 ramp

assumptions.Name: gemm_eps_max_nvfp4_grouped
assumptions.Scope: nvfp4: no efficiency ramp for the nvfp4_grouped kernel on b200, so it is priced on the nvfp4 ramp at the peak it computes at

assumptions.Name: all_reduce_message_limit
assumptions.Scope: the custom lane for every message size: the engine runs a message above the custom kernel's size limit on NCCL; the pool's tensor-parallel all-reduce is priced from the custom lane at every size (inference-sim/inference-sim#2478)

assumptions.Name: trtllm_gen_prefill_lane
assumptions.Scope: pooled: the trtllm-gen prefill pair cannot be shown valid for the prefill implementation reported (no implementation reported for attention.prefill): attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_bf16 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs; attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_fp8 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs. Needed: the code hash of the trtllm-gen prefill kernel of the engine's FlashInfer pin, which an engine release's kernel_impls.json would publish (inference-sim/inference-sim#2466), stated on the entries and reported by the engine as the implementation of attention.prefill. The part's pooled pair prices the prefill.

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: nontorch_in_budget_bytes_4rank
assumptions.Scope: 0: no fit-unit group measures the non-torch memory vLLM grows inside the KV budget for this model and part (non_kv_cache_memory, gpu_worker.py:720-756@v0.33.0), so none is charged and the KV budget is overstated by it

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.34.0+0fda86a35419 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

assumptions.Name: modality
assumptions.Scope: multimodal: the graph prices a vision tower, but the engine states none resident, so the tower's weights and any encode step are not priced

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: an fp32 router gate above 32 tokens runs bf16x3 on a Blackwell part (gate_linear.py:116-136): three BF16 GEMMs, a third of the BF16 peak, on the BF16 ramp

assumptions.Name: all_reduce_message_limit
assumptions.Scope: the custom lane for every message size: the engine runs a message above the custom kernel's size limit on NCCL; the pool's tensor-parallel all-reduce is priced from the custom lane at every size (inference-sim/inference-sim#2478)

assumptions.Name: trtllm_gen_prefill_lane
assumptions.Scope: pooled: the trtllm-gen prefill pair cannot be shown valid for the prefill implementation reported (no implementation reported for attention.prefill): attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_bf16 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs; attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_fp8 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs. Needed: the code hash of the trtllm-gen prefill kernel of the engine's FlashInfer pin, which an engine release's kernel_impls.json would publish (inference-sim/inference-sim#2466), stated on the entries and reported by the engine as the implementation of attention.prefill. The part's pooled pair prices the prefill.

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: nontorch_in_budget_bytes_4rank

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: FP32 weights run at the TF32 tensor-core rate, taken as half the dense BF16 peak as NVIDIA's datasheets state it for every catalog part; the catalog states no TF32 peak, and the ramp is BF16's

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_sparse_mla
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no per-kind decode rate for sparse_mla attention, so it is priced with the part-wide attention pair and any per-kind floor is not used

assumptions.Name: cache_record
assumptions.Scope: fp8: the graph lists no record under this cache dtype for some cache it states, so that cache is sized at its bytes_per_entry, the record under the cache dtype the graph's base description assumes

assumptions.Name: kv_cache_grouping
assumptions.Scope: per cache: the stated caches are sized at their own pages rather than in the engine's shared block pool, because the rules pack cannot group them: an unbalanced bucket of 91 layers would be split 3 ways, which leaves layers in no group

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_sparse_mla
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for sparse_mla attention, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on the attention FLOPs

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: mhc_rate_pre
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured mHC pre form, so the hyper-connection nodes are charged their stated bytes at HBM bandwidth and the hc_*fn GEMMs on the dense ramp

assumptions.Name: mhc_rate_post
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured mHC post form, so the hyper-connection nodes are charged their stated bytes at HBM bandwidth and the hc_*fn GEMMs on the dense ramp

assumptions.Name: nontorch_in_budget_bytes_1rank
assumptions.Scope: 0: no fit-unit group measures the non-torch memory vLLM grows inside the KV budget for this model and part (non_kv_cache_memory, gpu_worker.py:720-756@v0.33.0), so none is charged and the KV budget is overstated by it

assumptions.Name: routing_imbalance
assumptions.Scope: 1 (evenly loaded): no default-role routing profile for deepseek-v4-pro//decode/linear/ep8: every expert-parallel rank is priced at the mean rank's routed tokens and experts

assumptions.Name: moe_routing
assumptions.Scope: : the experts class vLLM resolves for fp8 routed experts (moe_backend "") is not resolved here, so no selection launch is counted

assumptions.Name: modality
assumptions.Scope: multimodal: the graph prices a vision tower, but the engine states none resident, so the tower's weights and any encode step are not priced

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: an fp32 router gate above 32 tokens runs F.linear on the fp32 weight (gate_linear.py:116-136), SGEMM on CUDA cores at the datasheet FP32 rate since VLLM_FLOAT32_MATMUL_PRECISION defaults to highest (envs.py:92), on the BF16 ramp

assumptions.Name: all_reduce_message_limit
assumptions.Scope: the custom lane for every message size: the engine runs a message above the custom kernel's size limit on NCCL; the pool's tensor-parallel all-reduce is priced from the custom lane at every size (inference-sim/inference-sim#2478)

assumptions.Name: num_spec_tokens
assumptions.Scope: 3: the deployment drafts 3 tokens a step and the graph's speculator states 1; the passes are priced at the deployment's count, and what the graph sizes at its own count is taken as stated

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.34.0+0fda86a35419 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_bf16 is valid for flashinfer/trtllm_batch_context_with_kv_cache/21456cf0dbe7b20b1f233422c3d97802aef4bb236f4cc308b5f2852db18a59b8, and the engine reports no implementation of attention.prefill; attention_prefill_work_scale_trtllm_gen_kv_bf16 is valid for flashinfer/trtllm_batch_context_with_kv_cache/9be0f76701ed318b1e2d52a5662f7df33e9597a80445452d57a78c99bc29fbca, and the engine reports no implementation of attention.prefill; attention_prefill_work_scale_trtllm_gen_kv_bf16 is valid for flashinfer/trtllm_batch_context_with_kv_cache/21456cf0dbe7b20b1f233422c3d97802aef4bb236f4cc308b5f2852db18a59b8, and the engine reports no implementation of attention.prefill; a different build or kernel, or a prefill that also runs another, is not priced from it; attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_fp8 is valid for flashinfer/trtllm_batch_context_with_kv_cache/9be0f76701ed318b1e2d52a5662f7df33e9597a80445452d57a78c99bc29fbca, and the engine reports no implementation of attention.prefill; attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_fp8 is valid for flashinfer/trtllm_batch_context_with_kv_cache/21456cf0dbe7b20b1f233422c3d97802aef4bb236f4cc308b5f2852db18a59b8, and the engine reports no implementation of attention.prefill; attention_prefill_work_scale_trtllm_gen_kv_fp8 is valid for flashinfer/trtllm_batch_context_with_kv_cache/9be0f76701ed318b1e2d52a5662f7df33e9597a80445452d57a78c99bc29fbca, and the engine reports no implementation of attention.prefill; attention_prefill_work_scale_trtllm_gen_kv_fp8 is valid for flashinfer/trtllm_batch_context_with_kv_cache/21456cf0dbe7b20b1f233422c3d97802aef4bb236f4cc308b5f2852db18a59b8, and the engine reports no implementation of attention.prefill; a different build or kernel, or a prefill that also runs another, is not priced from it. Needed: the code hash of the trtllm-gen prefill kernel of the engine's FlashInfer pin, which an engine release's kernel_impls.json would publish (inference-sim/inference-sim#2466), stated on the entries and reported by the engine as the implementation of attention.prefill. The part's pooled pair prices the prefill.

assumptions.Scope: pooled: the trtllm-gen prefill pair cannot be shown valid for the prefill implementation reported (no implementation reported for attention.prefill): attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_bf16 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs; attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_fp8 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs. Needed: the code hash of the trtllm-gen prefill kernel of the engine's FlashInfer pin, which an engine release's kernel_impls.json would publish (inference-sim/inference-sim#2466), stated on the entries and reported by the engine as the implementation of attention.prefill. The part's pooled pair prices the prefill.

assumptions.Name: nontorch_in_budget_bytes_8rank

assumptions.Name: moe_routing
assumptions.Scope: : the experts class vLLM resolves for fp8 routed experts (moe_backend "") is not resolved here, so no selection launch is counted

assumptions.Name: modality
assumptions.Scope: multimodal: the graph prices a vision tower, but the engine states none resident, so the tower's weights and any encode step are not priced

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: an fp32 router gate above 32 tokens runs bf16x3 on a Blackwell part (gate_linear.py:116-136): three BF16 GEMMs, a third of the BF16 peak, on the BF16 ramp

assumptions.Name: all_reduce_message_limit
assumptions.Scope: the custom lane for every message size: the engine runs a message above the custom kernel's size limit on NCCL; the pool's tensor-parallel all-reduce is priced from the custom lane at every size (inference-sim/inference-sim#2478)

assumptions.Name: trtllm_gen_prefill_lane
assumptions.Scope: pooled: the trtllm-gen prefill pair cannot be shown valid for the prefill implementation reported (no implementation reported for attention.prefill): attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_bf16 is valid for flashinfer/trtllm_batch_context_with_kv_cache/9be0f76701ed318b1e2d52a5662f7df33e9597a80445452d57a78c99bc29fbca, and the engine reports no implementation of attention.prefill; attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_bf16 is valid for flashinfer/trtllm_batch_context_with_kv_cache/21456cf0dbe7b20b1f233422c3d97802aef4bb236f4cc308b5f2852db18a59b8, and the engine reports no implementation of attention.prefill; attention_prefill_work_scale_trtllm_gen_kv_bf16 is valid for flashinfer/trtllm_batch_context_with_kv_cache/9be0f76701ed318b1e2d52a5662f7df33e9597a80445452d57a78c99bc29fbca, and the engine reports no implementation of attention.prefill; attention_prefill_work_scale_trtllm_gen_kv_bf16 is valid for flashinfer/trtllm_batch_context_with_kv_cache/21456cf0dbe7b20b1f233422c3d97802aef4bb236f4cc308b5f2852db18a59b8, and the engine reports no implementation of attention.prefill; a different build or kernel, or a prefill that also runs another, is not priced from it; attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_fp8 is valid for flashinfer/trtllm_batch_context_with_kv_cache/9be0f76701ed318b1e2d52a5662f7df33e9597a80445452d57a78c99bc29fbca, and the engine reports no implementation of attention.prefill; attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_fp8 is valid for flashinfer/trtllm_batch_context_with_kv_cache/21456cf0dbe7b20b1f233422c3d97802aef4bb236f4cc308b5f2852db18a59b8, and the engine reports no implementation of attention.prefill; attention_prefill_work_scale_trtllm_gen_kv_fp8 is valid for flashinfer/trtllm_batch_context_with_kv_cache/9be0f76701ed318b1e2d52a5662f7df33e9597a80445452d57a78c99bc29fbca, and the engine reports no implementation of attention.prefill; attention_prefill_work_scale_trtllm_gen_kv_fp8 is valid for flashinfer/trtllm_batch_context_with_kv_cache/21456cf0dbe7b20b1f233422c3d97802aef4bb236f4cc308b5f2852db18a59b8, and the engine reports no implementation of attention.prefill; a different build or kernel, or a prefill that also runs another, is not priced from it. Needed: the code hash of the trtllm-gen prefill kernel of the engine's FlashInfer pin, which an engine release's kernel_impls.json would publish (inference-sim/inference-sim#2466), stated on the entries and reported by the engine as the implementation of attention.prefill. The part's pooled pair prices the prefill.

assumptions.Name: num_spec_tokens
assumptions.Scope: 3: the deployment drafts 3 tokens a step and the graph's speculator states 1; the passes are priced at the deployment's count, and what the graph sizes at its own count is taken as stated

assumptions.Name: cache_record
assumptions.Scope: fp8: the graph lists no record under this cache dtype for some cache it states, so that cache is sized at its bytes_per_entry, the record under the cache dtype the graph's base description assumes

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: nontorch_in_budget_bytes_4rank
assumptions.Scope: 0: no fit-unit group measures the non-torch memory vLLM grows inside the KV budget for this model and part (non_kv_cache_memory, gpu_worker.py:720-756@v0.33.0), so none is charged and the KV budget is overstated by it

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.34.0+0fda86a35419 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

assumptions.Name: moe_routing
assumptions.Scope: : the experts class vLLM resolves for fp8 routed experts (moe_backend "") is not resolved here, so no selection launch is counted

assumptions.Name: modality
assumptions.Scope: multimodal: the graph prices a vision tower, but the engine states none resident, so the tower's weights and any encode step are not priced

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: an fp32 router gate above 32 tokens runs bf16x3 on a Blackwell part (gate_linear.py:116-136): three BF16 GEMMs, a third of the BF16 peak, on the BF16 ramp

assumptions.Name: all_reduce_message_limit
assumptions.Scope: the custom lane for every message size: the engine runs a message above the custom kernel's size limit on NCCL; the pool's tensor-parallel all-reduce is priced from the custom lane at every size (inference-sim/inference-sim#2478)

assumptions.Name: trtllm_gen_prefill_lane
assumptions.Scope: pooled: the trtllm-gen prefill pair cannot be shown valid for the prefill implementation reported (no implementation reported for attention.prefill): attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_bf16 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs; attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_fp8 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs. Needed: the code hash of the trtllm-gen prefill kernel of the engine's FlashInfer pin, which an engine release's kernel_impls.json would publish (inference-sim/inference-sim#2466), stated on the entries and reported by the engine as the implementation of attention.prefill. The part's pooled pair prices the prefill.

assumptions.Name: num_spec_tokens
assumptions.Scope: 3: the deployment drafts 3 tokens a step and the graph's speculator states 1; the passes are priced at the deployment's count, and what the graph sizes at its own count is taken as stated

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: nontorch_in_budget_bytes_8rank
assumptions.Scope: 0: no fit-unit group measures the non-torch memory vLLM grows inside the KV budget for this model and part (non_kv_cache_memory, gpu_worker.py:720-756@v0.33.0), so none is charged and the KV budget is overstated by it

assumptions.Name: routing_imbalance
assumptions.Scope: 1 (evenly loaded): no default-role routing profile for minimax-m3-mxfp8//decode/linear/ep8: every expert-parallel rank is priced at the mean rank's routed tokens and experts

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.34.0+0fda86a35419 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

routing.reason: no default-role routing profile for minimax-m3-mxfp8//decode/linear/ep8

assumptions.Name: moe_routing
assumptions.Scope: fused: the TRT-LLM monolithic experts are first in the oracle's order and take router logits; the model's routing method is taken to be one they support (DeepSeekV3, Renormalize, Sigmoid or MiniMax2), as every catalog MoE family's is

assumptions.Name: encoder
assumptions.Scope: priced as a substitution: the tower is priced with the decoder's GEMM efficiency ramp (BF16) and its measured prefill-attention rate, bidirectional and with no KV cache; no allowed data measures an encoder step, so every point with an encode step is capped, and the tower's collectives and fused kernels are not priced

assumptions.Name: gemm_eps_max_nvfp4_grouped
assumptions.Scope: nvfp4: no efficiency ramp for the nvfp4_grouped kernel on b200, so it is priced on the nvfp4 ramp at the peak it computes at

assumptions.Name: all_reduce_message_limit
assumptions.Scope: the custom lane for every message size: the engine runs a message above the custom kernel's size limit on NCCL; the pool's tensor-parallel all-reduce is priced from the custom lane at every size (inference-sim/inference-sim#2478)

assumptions.Name: moe_routing
assumptions.Scope: : the experts class vLLM resolves for fp8 routed experts (moe_backend "") is not resolved here, so no selection launch is counted

assumptions.Name: modality
assumptions.Scope: multimodal: the graph prices a vision tower, but the engine states none resident, so the tower's weights and any encode step are not priced

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: an fp32 router gate above 32 tokens runs bf16x3 on a Blackwell part (gate_linear.py:116-136): three BF16 GEMMs, a third of the BF16 peak, on the BF16 ramp

assumptions.Name: all_reduce_message_limit
assumptions.Scope: the custom lane for every message size: the engine runs a message above the custom kernel's size limit on NCCL; the pool's tensor-parallel all-reduce is priced from the custom lane at every size (inference-sim/inference-sim#2478)

assumptions.Name: trtllm_gen_prefill_lane
assumptions.Scope: pooled: the trtllm-gen prefill pair cannot be shown valid for the prefill implementation reported (no implementation reported for attention.prefill): attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_bf16 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs; attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_fp8 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs. Needed: the code hash of the trtllm-gen prefill kernel of the engine's FlashInfer pin, which an engine release's kernel_impls.json would publish (inference-sim/inference-sim#2466), stated on the entries and reported by the engine as the implementation of attention.prefill. The part's pooled pair prices the prefill.

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: nontorch_in_budget_bytes_8rank
assumptions.Scope: 0: no fit-unit group measures the non-torch memory vLLM grows inside the KV budget for this model and part (non_kv_cache_memory, gpu_worker.py:720-756@v0.33.0), so none is charged and the KV budget is overstated by it

assumptions.Name: routing_imbalance
assumptions.Scope: 1 (evenly loaded): no default-role routing profile for minimax-m3-mxfp8//decode/linear/ep8: every expert-parallel rank is priced at the mean rank's routed tokens and experts

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.34.0+0fda86a35419 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

routing.reason: no default-role routing profile for minimax-m3-mxfp8//decode/linear/ep8

assumptions.Name: moe_routing
assumptions.Scope: : the experts class vLLM resolves for mxfp4 routed experts (moe_backend "") is not resolved here, so no selection launch is counted

assumptions.Name: all_reduce_message_limit
assumptions.Scope: the custom lane for every message size: the engine runs a message above the custom kernel's size limit on NCCL; the pool's tensor-parallel all-reduce is priced from the custom lane at every size (inference-sim/inference-sim#2478)

assumptions.Name: trtllm_gen_prefill_lane
assumptions.Scope: pooled: the trtllm-gen prefill pair cannot be shown valid for the prefill implementation reported (no implementation reported for attention.prefill): attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_bf16 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs; attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_fp8 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs. Needed: the code hash of the trtllm-gen prefill kernel of the engine's FlashInfer pin, which an engine release's kernel_impls.json would publish (inference-sim/inference-sim#2466), stated on the entries and reported by the engine as the implementation of attention.prefill. The part's pooled pair prices the prefill.

assumptions.Name: nontorch_in_budget_bytes_2rank
assumptions.Scope: 0: no fit-unit group measures the non-torch memory vLLM grows inside the KV budget for this model and part (non_kv_cache_memory, gpu_worker.py:720-756@v0.33.0), so none is charged and the KV budget is overstated by it

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.34.0+0fda86a35419 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

assumptions.Name: moe_routing
assumptions.Scope: fused: the TRT-LLM monolithic experts are first in the oracle's order and take router logits; the model's routing method is taken to be one they support (DeepSeekV3, Renormalize, Sigmoid or MiniMax2), as every catalog MoE family's is

assumptions.Name: modality
assumptions.Scope: multimodal: the graph prices a vision tower, but the engine states none resident, so the tower's weights and any encode step are not priced

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: an fp32 router gate above 32 tokens runs bf16x3 on a Blackwell part (gate_linear.py:116-136): three BF16 GEMMs, a third of the BF16 peak, on the BF16 ramp

assumptions.Name: gemm_eps_max_nvfp4_grouped
assumptions.Scope: nvfp4: no efficiency ramp for the nvfp4_grouped kernel on b200, so it is priced on the nvfp4 ramp at the peak it computes at

assumptions.Name: all_reduce_message_limit
assumptions.Scope: the custom lane for every message size: the engine runs a message above the custom kernel's size limit on NCCL; the pool's tensor-parallel all-reduce is priced from the custom lane at every size (inference-sim/inference-sim#2478)

assumptions.Name: trtllm_gen_prefill_lane
assumptions.Scope: pooled: the trtllm-gen prefill pair cannot be shown valid for the prefill implementation reported (no implementation reported for attention.prefill): attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_bf16 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs; attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_fp8 states no kernel implementation it is valid for (kernel_impls), so it applies to every build of the kernel and nothing shows it was measured on, or moved to, the one the engine runs. Needed: the code hash of the trtllm-gen prefill kernel of the engine's FlashInfer pin, which an engine release's kernel_impls.json would publish (inference-sim/inference-sim#2466), stated on the entries and reported by the engine as the implementation of attention.prefill. The part's pooled pair prices the prefill.

assumptions.Name: cache_record
assumptions.Scope: fp8: the graph lists no record under this cache dtype for some cache it states, so that cache is sized at its bytes_per_entry, the record under the cache dtype the graph's base description assumes

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: nontorch_in_budget_bytes_2rank
assumptions.Scope: 0: no fit-unit group measures the non-torch memory vLLM grows inside the KV budget for this model and part (non_kv_cache_memory, gpu_worker.py:720-756@v0.33.0), so none is charged and the KV budget is overstated by it

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.34.0+0fda86a35419 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

assumptions.Name: moe_routing
assumptions.Scope: fused: the TRT-LLM monolithic experts are first in the oracle's order and take router logits; the model's routing method is taken to be one they support (DeepSeekV3, Renormalize, Sigmoid or MiniMax2), as every catalog MoE family's is

assumptions.Name: modality
assumptions.Scope: multimodal: the graph prices a vision tower, but the engine states none resident, so the tower's weights and any encode step are not priced

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: an fp32 router gate above 32 tokens runs bf16x3 on a Blackwell part (gate_linear.py:116-136): three BF16 GEMMs, a third of the BF16 peak, on the BF16 ramp

assumptions.Name: gemm_eps_max_nvfp4_grouped
assumptions.Scope: nvfp4: no efficiency ramp for the nvfp4_grouped kernel on b300, so it is priced on the nvfp4 ramp at the peak it computes at

assumptions.Name: all_reduce_message_limit
assumptions.Scope: the custom lane for every message size: the engine runs a message above the custom kernel's size limit on NCCL; the pool's tensor-parallel all-reduce is priced from the custom lane at every size (inference-sim/inference-sim#2478)

assumptions.Name: trtllm_gen_prefill_lane
assumptions.Scope: pooled: the trtllm-gen prefill pair cannot be shown valid for the prefill implementation reported (no implementation reported for attention.prefill): attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_bf16 is valid for flashinfer/trtllm_batch_context_with_kv_cache/9be0f76701ed318b1e2d52a5662f7df33e9597a80445452d57a78c99bc29fbca, and the engine reports no implementation of attention.prefill; attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_bf16 is valid for flashinfer/trtllm_batch_context_with_kv_cache/21456cf0dbe7b20b1f233422c3d97802aef4bb236f4cc308b5f2852db18a59b8, and the engine reports no implementation of attention.prefill; attention_prefill_work_scale_trtllm_gen_kv_bf16 is valid for flashinfer/trtllm_batch_context_with_kv_cache/9be0f76701ed318b1e2d52a5662f7df33e9597a80445452d57a78c99bc29fbca, and the engine reports no implementation of attention.prefill; attention_prefill_work_scale_trtllm_gen_kv_bf16 is valid for flashinfer/trtllm_batch_context_with_kv_cache/21456cf0dbe7b20b1f233422c3d97802aef4bb236f4cc308b5f2852db18a59b8, and the engine reports no implementation of attention.prefill; a different build or kernel, or a prefill that also runs another, is not priced from it; attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_fp8 is valid for flashinfer/trtllm_batch_context_with_kv_cache/9be0f76701ed318b1e2d52a5662f7df33e9597a80445452d57a78c99bc29fbca, and the engine reports no implementation of attention.prefill; attention_prefill_floor_trtllm_gen_kv_fp8 is valid for flashinfer/trtllm_batch_context_with_kv_cache/21456cf0dbe7b20b1f233422c3d97802aef4bb236f4cc308b5f2852db18a59b8, and the engine reports no implementation of attention.prefill; attention_prefill_work_scale_trtllm_gen_kv_fp8 is valid for flashinfer/trtllm_batch_context_with_kv_cache/9be0f76701ed318b1e2d52a5662f7df33e9597a80445452d57a78c99bc29fbca, and the engine reports no implementation of attention.prefill; attention_prefill_work_scale_trtllm_gen_kv_fp8 is valid for flashinfer/trtllm_batch_context_with_kv_cache/21456cf0dbe7b20b1f233422c3d97802aef4bb236f4cc308b5f2852db18a59b8, and the engine reports no implementation of attention.prefill; a different build or kernel, or a prefill that also runs another, is not priced from it. Needed: the code hash of the trtllm-gen prefill kernel of the engine's FlashInfer pin, which an engine release's kernel_impls.json would publish (inference-sim/inference-sim#2466), stated on the entries and reported by the engine as the implementation of attention.prefill. The part's pooled pair prices the prefill.

assumptions.Name: cache_record
assumptions.Scope: fp8: the graph lists no record under this cache dtype for some cache it states, so that cache is sized at its bytes_per_entry, the record under the cache dtype the graph's base description assumes

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: nontorch_in_budget_bytes_8rank
assumptions.Scope: 0: no fit-unit group measures the non-torch memory vLLM grows inside the KV budget for this model and part (non_kv_cache_memory, gpu_worker.py:720-756@v0.33.0), so none is charged and the KV budget is overstated by it

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.34.0+0fda86a35419 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)
